title: Website editorial-to-CMS/Brand/Wire publication authority
summary: Website Publisher v0.3 export and native read-back can now be staged offline by Rasen Falcon v0.4.2 site compiler, with strict nine-page schema/site checks, digest provenance and isolated noindex preview. The browser editor and candidate CLI remain outside authenticated CMS/Brand/Wire publication authority.
invariants: Website Publisher v0.3 runs a side-by-side editor with import/export, review-request preparation and revision compare; browser export is not a release or authenticated review.
Native Publisher v0.3 uses NoSQLServer v0.90 candidate as an explicitly qualified offline file-to-ooRexx CLI handoff, not a browser-connected CMS service.
NoSQLServer v0.91 exists as an additional candidate but cannot silently replace the v0.90 pinned Publisher source without full qualification.
CMS/Brand Builder must hold editorial truth and review authority; a local string, SHA-256 or timestamp is not a verified approval receipt.
Wire UI Builder/Resource Editor composes and projects semantically typed resources; pending real resource authority receipts must not be invented.
ooRexx HTTPS Server is the owned public listener; public apex routes must not inherit Office/NOC private TLS or capability states.
Only authenticated and independently checked CMS, brand approval and Wire resource release receipts may allow a future production site build.
All nine preview pages emit noindex,nofollow independent of editorial approval flags; production fails closed until the receipt verifier is genuinely implemented.
No remote persistence, multi-writer safety, live publishing, RexxOS commissioning, ACME/SNI or operator approval is claimed by the offline editor or static tests.
Candidate staging accepts only publisher.export/0.1 or native-record/0.2 with candidate authority, exact site and page identity; other schemas and conflicting/extra page/approval fields fail closed.
Staging records SHA-256 of the received bytes and normalized candidate pages, but native revision is explicitly unverified and every imported page becomes candidate regardless of claimed approval.
Output is staged to a new path atomically, never overwrite/delete the source or an existing review directory; isolated preview is noindex.
Production must continue to refuse even complete candidate bundles: authentication, institutional Brand decision and Wire release receipts are not implemented.
General Deployment local review staging must remain noindex and cannot act as CMS/Brand/Wire release evidence, install a service, or enable public DNS/TLS.

provenance.claim: Publisher native snapshot/revision handoff and explicit missing live authenticated CMS service.
Prior public site and deployment boundary.
Real CLI candidate staging, offline integration, negative cases and review-only output.

integration_steps: Use Website Publisher v0.3 export/0.1 or native-record/0.2 and stage with tools/site.py stage-publisher INPUT NEW_STAGING_DIR; preview with --content-dir staging/content --output-dir NEW_PREVIEW_DIR.
Implement authenticated ooRexx CMS candidate read/write and review service against an accepted NoSQLServer backend.
Bind identity, authorship, brand approval and source/revision lineage with an independently verifiable release receipt.
Compile/publish Wire resources under their own authority and check resource receipt linkage to each page version.
Only then enable production mode in the site compiler and qualify native HTTPS/SNI, cache and rollback on target host.

publisher_to_site_bridge.preview_command: python3 website/tools/site.py build --mode preview --content-dir STAGE/content --output-dir NEW_PREVIEW_DIRECTORY
